_info: Webhooks and scripts J.A.R.V.I.S. may use. Set enabled=true to activate them. ${VAR} is replaced with the environment variable (.env).

webhooks.name: test_echo
webhooks.description: Test webhook: sends a payload to httpbin.org and returns the echo (useful to check the integration works).

webhooks.name: living_room_lights
webhooks.description: Turns the living room lights on/off via Home Assistant. payload: {"action": "on"|"off"}

webhooks.name: add_calendar_event
webhooks.description: Creates a calendar event (e.g. via Zapier/Make/n8n). payload: {"title", "start" ISO, "duration_min"}

scripts.name: save_note
scripts.description: Saves a text note to data/notes.txt on the server. argument = the note text.
